title: Shaymin (Poke Ball Pattern) 087/131 Sv: Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Shaymin card from the Prismatic Evolutions set features a unique Poke Ball pattern design, showcasing the character Shaymin in a holo finish. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2025, this English-language card has an HP of 70 and is classified as an uncommon rarity. With artwork by Amelicart, this basic stage Pokémon card is a must-have for collectors and fans of the Pokémon TCG.
